title: Chemchemi Bottled Water 500ml (24-pack) at Nairobi Distribution Centre has fallen below its reorder level
description: Available stock of Chemchemi Bottled Water 500ml (24-pack) at Nairobi Distribution Centre has dropped below the reorder level, triggering a replenishment review.
businessContext: INV-POL-001 requires the Inventory Manager to review demand, open purchase orders, other warehouses and lead time whenever quantityAvailable falls below reorderLevel.

events.event: A cycle review finds quantityAvailable (102) below reorderLevel (200) for Chemchemi Bottled Water 500ml (24-pack) at Nairobi Distribution Centre.
Michael Odhiambo Owino reviews demand, open purchase orders and stock at other warehouses.
A purchase request or transfer is considered, but is not an automatic commitment.

expectedOutcome: Per INV-POL-001, the Inventory Manager (Michael Odhiambo Owino) reviews demand, open purchase orders, stock in other warehouses and expected lead time before a purchase request or transfer is raised; reaching the reorder level is a review trigger, not an automatic purchase commitment, and the resulting request would still follow PROC-POL-001 and FIN-POL-002.
relevantFacts: Chemchemi Bottled Water 500ml (24-pack) (PRD-013) at Nairobi Distribution Centre (WH-NRB-001) has quantityOnHand 120, quantityReserved 18, quantityAvailable 102, reorderLevel 200 (inventory record INV-0013).

INV-POL-001: 'When quantityAvailable falls below reorderLevel, the Inventory Manager reviews demand, open purchase orders, stock in other warehouses and expected lead time. The resulting purchase request or transfer follows PROC-POL-001 and FIN-POL-002; a reorder signal is not an automatic purchase commitment.'
requiredReasoning: Identify who is responsible for the replenishment review.
Recognise that crossing the reorder level does not itself authorise a purchase.
